body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Etón(www.etoncorp.com) presented its self-powered weather radio 'Microlink FR160' at CES 2010.
It offers AM/FM reception and access to all seven NOAA channels. Additional features include LED flashlight, solar power and cell phone charger.
• Powered by solar or dynamo both of which charge internal Ni-MH battery
• USB cell phone charger (USB cable not included)
• Etón Corporation will contribute $0.49 to $1.00 of the sales price of each Red Cross product to support the American Red Cross.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
